text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":4,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"the red rope was four times the length of the blue rope"},{"id":"q2","value":7,"unit":"centimeters","kind":"count","span":"7 centimeters shorter than the yellow rope"},{"id":"q3","value":37,"unit":"centimeters","kind":"count","span":"combined length of 37 centimeters"},{"id":"q4","value":3,"unit":"ropes","kind":"count","span":"the 3 ropes had a combined length"}],"plan":[{"op":"sub","args":["q3","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"removes the 7cm extra that yellow has over blue from the total combined length, part of solving the system for the three rope lengths"},{"op":"div","args":["s1","q1"],"out":"s2","note":"divides by the red-to-blue ratio (4), part of isolating the blue rope's base length in the linear system"},{"op":"mul","args":["s2","q1"],"out":"s3","note":"scales the derived component back up by the red-to-blue ratio to estimate the red rope's length"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"the length of the red rope in centimeters"},"dismissed":[{"value":3,"reason":"the '3 ropes' just restates that there are three ropes (red, blue, yellow) already named in the problem; it isn't a separate quantity used in the length equations"}]}
